item.title: Matheson fills vacant council seat
item.description: Black River-Matheson council has selected a new member to fill a vacant seat at the table. At its March 10 meeting, Rebecca Pepper was chosen to represent Ward 5. item.description: Kirkland Lake Gold Miners defenceman Fynn Manttari has been named to the Northern Ontario Junior Hockey League’s second all-rookie team.
